entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-09
entry.content:
Issues

  • TestGetRecoveredTextAsync does not reliably pass on Linux #83118
  • OnAutoInsert_EnterKey3 fails on Linux #83117
  • Disabled cases in CreateAbsoluteUri_LocalPaths_Unix #83116
  • Nullability removed when creating anonymous type #83114
  • Misleading error for #! not being on the first line and column #83111
    Backlog
  • "enable" is suggested for `#pragma warning` directives #83110

Closed

    Backlog
